title: Tigh's Best Ducati Motorcycle Trips
body:
My name is Tigh, and I've been incredibly lucky over the past few years,  exploring one of my greatest passions in life, traveling across the world on a motorcycle.  I write about [riding Ducati bikes in and out of New York City](https://www.nyducati.com/), but amazingly enough, I've also had the chance to ride through Italy, Switzerland, Canada, Turkey and all around the United States.  
  
Here are a few of my favorite trips, accompanied by some pictures I've had the chance to take along the way...  
[  
](https://www.nyducati.com/p/california-west-coast.html)
